facts.fact: The IPDCP says its work with the media regulator HARC aims to root compliance with the requirements of Togo's law on the protection of personal data, with measures the law provides where needed.
facts.system: loi relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The IPDCP, headed by president Colonel Béléi Bédiani, put a team into HARC's monitoring service on 19 October 2026 under a partnership convention signed on 10 December 2025.
facts.system: Instance de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (IPDCP)
